Locating agents are often used in paper chromatography.
Which mixture requires a locating agent?
A
a mixture of two colourless substances
B
a mixture of two insoluble substances
C
a mixture of two different-coloured substances with the same Rf value
D
a mixture of two substances that are the same colour
